-- Spawns zombies at the arena edge, chases the nearest player, and applies blade damage.
-- Blades are moved client-side, so hits are computed here from the same shared orbit math.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local BladeConfig = require(Shared.Config).Blades
local Config = require(Shared.Config).Zombies
local BladeMath = require(Shared.BladeMath)
local Coins = require(script.Parent.Coins)
local Shop = require(script.Parent.Shop)

local bladesRoot = workspace:WaitForChild("Blades")

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Zombies"
folder.Parent = workspace

local alive = 0
local lastAttacker: { [Model]: Player } = {}
local lastHit: { [Model]: { [string]: number } } = {}

local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = pos
	part.Color = Config.Color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	return part
end

local function award(zombie: Model)
	local player = lastAttacker[zombie]
	local stats = player and player.Parent and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		return
	end
	Coins.add(player, math.round(Config.CoinsPerKill * (1 + (player:GetAttribute("CoinBonus") or 0))))
	stats.Kills.Value += 1

	local heal = player:GetAttribute("LifeSteal")
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if heal and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health += heal -- Humanoid clamps to MaxHealth
	end
end

local function spawnZombie(health: number)
	local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
	-- Square arena: project the random direction onto the square edge.
	local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
	local scale = Config.SpawnRadius / math.max(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Z))
	local pos = dir * scale + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)

	local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
	zombie.Name = "Zombie"

	local root = makePart("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos)
	local head = makePart("Head", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.75, 0))
	local legs = makePart("Legs", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	for _, part in { head, legs } do
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = root
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.Parent = part
	end
	root.Parent = zombie
	head.Parent = zombie
	legs.Parent = zombie

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.MaxHealth = health
	humanoid.Health = health
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.HipHeight = 2
	humanoid.Parent = zombie

	zombie.PrimaryPart = root
	zombie.Parent = folder
	root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

	alive += 1
	lastHit[zombie] = {}
	local finished = false
	local function finish()
		if finished then
			return
		end
		finished = true
		alive -= 1
		lastAttacker[zombie] = nil
		lastHit[zombie] = nil
	end
	-- Zombies removed without dying (e.g. falling out of the world) must still stop counting
	-- as alive, otherwise the wave never ends and the shop never opens.
	zombie.Destroying:Connect(finish)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if finished then
			return
		end
		award(zombie)
		finish()
		task.delay(1, function()
			zombie:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end

local function nearestPlayerRoot(from: Vector3): BasePart?
	local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
			local dist = (hrp.Position - from).Magnitude
			if dist < bestDist then
				best, bestDist = hrp, dist
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Waves: spawn the wave's quota (capped by MaxAlive at once), wait for it to be cleared, then break.
task.spawn(function()
	local wave = 1
	while true do
		local quota = Config.FirstWaveCount + Config.CountPerWave * (wave - 1)
		local health = Config.Health * (1 + Config.HealthGrowth * (wave - 1))
		local spawned = 0
		while spawned < quota or alive > 0 do
			if spawned < quota and alive < Config.MaxAlive and #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 then
				spawnZombie(health)
				spawned += 1
			end
			task.wait(Config.SpawnInterval)
		end
		Shop.open()
		task.wait(Config.WaveBreak)
		Shop.close()
		wave += 1
	end
end)

-- Contact damage
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
		local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
		if not (humanoid and root) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= Config.ContactRadius then
				hum:TakeDamage(Config.ContactDamage * dt)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Chasing
task.spawn(function()

		for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
			local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
				local target = nearestPlayerRoot(root.Position)
				if target then
					humanoid:MoveTo(target.Position)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

				end

					continue
				end
				hits[key] = now
				lastAttacker[zombie] = player
				humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Between-wave upgrade shop. All state and purchase rules live on the server;
-- clients only display offers and send slot numbers.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)
local Coins = require(script.Parent.Coins)

local ShopConfig = Config.Shop

local isOpen = false
local offers: { [Player]: { { Id: string, Bought: boolean } } } = {}

local function bump(player: Player, name: string, amount: number, default: number)
	player:SetAttribute(name, (player:GetAttribute(name) or default) + amount)
end

local function applyMaxHealth(player: Player, heal: number?)
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Player.MaxHealth + (player:GetAttribute("BonusMaxHealth") or 0)
	if heal then
		humanoid.Health += heal
	end
end

-- Attributes replicate to clients, so visual ones (Reach, SpinMult) need no remote.
local effects = {
	Blade = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "BladeCount", amount, Config.Blades.StartCount)
	end,
	Damage = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "DamageBonus", amount, 0)
	end,
	Spin = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "SpinMult", amount, 1)
	end,
	Reach = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "Reach", amount, 0)
	end,
	Vitality = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "BonusMaxHealth", amount, 0)
		applyMaxHealth(player, amount)
	end,
	Vampiric = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "LifeSteal", amount, 0)
	end,
	Greed = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "CoinBonus", amount, 0)
	end,
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ShopConfig.Upgrades do
	byId[upgrade.Id] = upgrade
end

-- Weighted pick without replacement so a shop never shows the same upgrade twice.
local function roll(): { { Id: string, Bought: boolean } }
	local pool = table.clone(ShopConfig.Upgrades)
	local result = {}
	for _ = 1, math.min(ShopConfig.OfferCount, #pool) do
		local total = 0
		for _, upgrade in pool do
			total += ShopConfig.RarityWeight[upgrade.Rarity]
		end
		local pick = math.random() * total
		for i, upgrade in pool do
			pick -= ShopConfig.RarityWeight[upgrade.Rarity]
			if pick <= 0 or i == #pool then
				table.insert(result, { Id = upgrade.Id, Bought = false })
				table.remove(pool, i)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function send(player: Player)
	local list = {}
	for _, offer in offers[player] or {} do
		local upgrade = byId[offer.Id]
		table.insert(list, {
			Name = upgrade.Name,
			Rarity = upgrade.Rarity,
			Cost = upgrade.Cost,
			Description = upgrade.Description,
			Bought = offer.Bought,
		})
	end
	Remotes.ShopUpdate:FireClient(player, { Open = isOpen, RerollCost = ShopConfig.RerollCost, Offers = list })
end

local Shop = {}

function Shop.open()
	isOpen = true
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		offers[player] = roll()
		send(player)
	end
end

function Shop.close()
	isOpen = false
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		send(player)
	end
end

Remotes.ShopSync.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if isOpen and not offers[player] then
		offers[player] = roll()
	end
	send(player)
end)

Remotes.BuyOffer.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, slot)
	local list = offers[player]
	if not isOpen or not list or type(slot) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local offer = list[slot]
	if not offer or offer.Bought then
		return
	end
	local upgrade = byId[offer.Id]
	if not Coins.trySpend(player, upgrade.Cost) then
		return
	end
	offer.Bought = true
	effects[upgrade.Id](player, upgrade.Amount)
	send(player)
end)

Remotes.RerollOffers.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if not isOpen or not Coins.trySpend(player, ShopConfig.RerollCost) then
		return
	end
	offers[player] = roll()
	send(player)
end)

local function watchCharacter(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.defer(applyMaxHealth, player)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	watchCharacter(player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	offers[player] = nil
end)

return Shop

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	return stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")

	local value = getValue(player)

	end

function Coins.trySpend(player: Player, amount: number): boolean
	local value = getValue(player)
	if not value or value.Value < amount then
		return false
	end
	value.Value -= amount
	return true
end
